remarks: Welcome to this extraordinary townhouse that offers the ultimate convenience and comfort of home. Located just steps away from New Canaan's renowned library, restaurants, premier shopping, and the train station for easy access to NYC, this home brings the best of the town to your doorstep.  Not only is this townhome perfectly situated, but it also offers exceptional features that make it truly special. Spanning three finished levels, with the potential for expansion on the third floor, this quality-built home is designed to meet your evolving needs.  Step into the bright and sunny living room, where large windows allow natural sunlight to fill the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The cozy wood burning fireplace adds a touch of charm and provides a perfect spot to relax and unwind.  The eat-in kitchen, complete with sliders to the patio, is ideal for easy entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom features an office area and his-and-her primary baths, ensuring comfort and convenience. An additional en-suite bedroom and a den/office provide ample space for guests or a home office setup.  The finished lower level boasts a cozy family room, perfect for movie nights or quiet relaxation. The private backyard offers a serene oasis for grilling and enjoying the outdoors. Additionally, a one car attached garage, with one additional parking space available. Experience luxury living in this prime location.
